(2003), A&A 400, 137 also take the galaxy's distance for it). The galaxy's distance: RadburnSmith2011ApJS..195...18R: The GHOSTS Survey. I. Hubble Space Telescope Advanced Camera for Surveys Data (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJS..195...18R); catalogue reference RadburnSmith2011ApJS..195...18R: 3467368.50453 pc (-109992.362096/+113595.866501); trgb

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 15,000 K and log g 2.76 (u1 0.168, u2 0.306): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
